lots.title: R&B Distillers 6YO L.A. Daly Wild Child Straight Kentucky Bourbon, Japanese import
lots.seen_in_photos: Black novelty label with B&W portrait of a woman, signed L.A. Daly, R&B logo; black screw cap with tamper band; Japanese import back label; fill high in neck with some sediment flecks.
lots.text_read: R&B; Straight Kentucky Bourbon; Rhythm & Blues Distillers; Produced in Kentucky; 6 Year Old; 40% ALC. / VOL. 80 PROOF; Japanese back label: bourbon whiskey, grain/malt, 750ml, 40 degrees, USA, importer Selva Tokushima branch (Tokushima city address)
lots.not_in_title: Nothing material; photos match title. Celebrity-type novelty bottling.
lots.reason: Fully described by the title. Novelty label, no rare distillery or age beyond what is stated. Modest collectible only.
lots.bottling_era: 1990s to 2000s: screw cap, Japanese import label, 40% and 80 proof, matches Webb's circa.
lots.condition: Fill in neck about 4-5 cm below cap; sediment flecks at surface; back label corner slightly lifted. Cap intact.
lots.unreadable: Cap and tax-style marks fine print; Tokushima street number partly read.

lots.title: T.W. Samuels Bottled in Bond 100 Proof, 750ml, circa late 1990s/early 2000s
lots.seen_in_photos: White front label with black band 'Every Drop Kentucky Bourbon', crest, neck label with barcode, white plastic screw cap, NZ importer sticker on back, high fill.
lots.text_read: T.W. Samuels; Established 1844; Bottled in Bond Under U.S. Government Supervision; 100 PROOF; 50% ALC/VOL (100 PROOF); Bottled by T.W. Samuels Distillery, Bardstown, Nelson Co., Ky; back: Distilled by Heaven Hill Distilleries Inc, D.S.P. Ky. 31, Bardstown Kentucky 40004; Bottled By T.W. Samuels Distillery D.S.P. Ky 31; importer sticker: Imported by Heaven Hill Distilleries NZ Ltd, 3 Sydney St Petone 325847-4, Contains approx. 30 standard drinks, 50% alc/vol 750ml, www.heavenhill.co.nz; barcode 0 96749 04137 4; surgeon general warning on neck.
lots.not_in_title: Heaven Hill as distiller; NZ importer sticker; barcode and warning text. No older tax strip.
lots.reason: Accurately described, common Heaven Hill brand with plain barcode and warning, post-1989. Nothing hidden.
lots.bottling_era: Late 1990s to 2000s: barcode, government warning (post-1989), NZ importer sticker with standard drinks count, screw cap.
lots.condition: Neck label foxed and stained at top, slight tear; label and sticker age spotting; fill very high.

lots.title: NZ Whisky Co Wilson's 21YO Matured Blend, 42.7%, 500ml (GB)
lots.seen_in_photos: Black gift box with NZ map; round bottle embossed NEW ZEALAND WHISKY; black wax-style cap with small notch; cream label with red 21 roundel; fill at shoulder.
lots.text_read: Wilson's Matured Blend Whisky; Aged 21 Years; Distilled from the finest quality Malt and New Zealand Barley; Product of New Zealand, Wilson Distillers, Dunedin; 42.7% alcohol 500ML; back: Since 1863 the Wilson family... first whiskies for Wilson's Matured Blend in 1969. Dunedin's famed Willowbank Distillery... closed down in 1997. This VERY limited release of Wilson's 21-year-old Matured Blend from the last few remaining barrels, celebrates the revival of distilling in Dunedin. The New Zealand Whisky Collection; Produced by The New Zealand Whisky Co. Limited, Oamaru; thenzwhisky.com; 500mL 42.7% abv; barcode 9421014231500; Standard drinks 18.
lots.not_in_title: Willowbank Distillery (closed 1997) origin, 'very limited release' from last remaining barrels. Collectors seek Willowbank whisky.
lots.title_errors: Title says 'Whisk' (typo); Wilson Distillers, Dunedin named on front, minor
lots.reason: Willowbank is a sought-after closed NZ distillery and the back label says very limited release from last barrels; title does not name Willowbank, but NZ Whisky Co 21 YO is commonly listed so searchers will mostly find it. Modest upside.
lots.bottling_era: Circa 2010s (NZ Whisky Collection release, barcode, 18 standard drinks), distilled at Willowbank pre-1997.
lots.condition: Good; cap seal notch (cut tab) at neck suggests tamper strip opened or seal cut, check; fill at shoulder, no obvious loss.

lots.title: Wilson's 7YO Superior Blend Whisky, 1000ml, 37.5%
lots.seen_in_photos: Clear bottle with cream label, wax-style seal on neck reading Reed Wilson Superior Blend 7 yrs, black screw cap, pale straw spirit, fill low in neck.
lots.text_read: Wilson's Superior Blend Whisky; Distilled from the finest quality malt and New Zealand barley; 37.5% ALC/VOL 1000ml; back: Scotch-style whisky with high malt content of nearly 50%, grain and malt matured separately in oak barrels for 7 years; contains approx 29 standard drinks; proudly distributed by The Continental Wines and Spirits Company (N.Z.) Limited, Mayber Pass Road [sic, read as Mayberry/Mt Wellington], Grafton, Auckland; barcode 9414306145104; batch code L2221 WW105 022351; seal text REED WILSON ... SUPERIOR BLEND ... 7 yrs.
lots.not_in_title: Reed Wilson seal; distributor details; batch code.
lots.reason: Ordinary modern NZ blend, accurately described.
lots.condition: Fill about 3 cm into neck, slight evaporation or seepage; label lightly marked; spirit clear.

lots.title: 2019 Kweichow Flying Fairy Moutai with 2 glasses, 53%, 500ml (GB)
lots.seen_in_photos: Boxed bottle, white ceramic with red label and ribbon, red capsule, two Moutai glasses, 2019 on back; fill not assessable (ceramic).
lots.text_read: Kweichow Moutai; 53% vol; 500ml; 53% vol. 106 PROOF 500mL 16.9 fl oz (partially read); Produce of Kweichow Moutai Co., Ltd.; capsule inkjet: 20190516 / 2018-144 / AM0743 (partly legible); back: Chinese text and English blurb; 2019.
lots.not_in_title: Bottling date 16 May 2019 on capsule; batch code 2018-144. Note small tear in capsule.

lots.title: Angostura Old Oak Trinidad Rum and John Peel British Guiana Old Rum miniatures, circa 1950s-70s
lots.seen_in_photos: Two small bottles. Left: Angostura Old Oak Trinidad rum, black screw cap, heavily foxed label, fill dropped to about one third to half with foam residue. Right: flask John Peel Old Rum, red cap, hunting scene label, fill high, dark rear panel.
lots.text_read: Angostura Light Dry; OLD OAK TRINIDAD RUM; Gold Label (faint); Bottled in Bond; small print about bottled under Government supervision, partly illegible, fl oz and % mentioned but unreadable; Angostura crest. JOHN PEEL Old Rum, Produce of British Guiana, 70 degrees PROOF, Specially blended for and bottled by The Hull Brewery Co. Ltd. Hull.
lots.not_in_title: Angostura bottled in bond; Hull Brewery bottling for John Peel; 70 proof. Era matches pre-1980 (proof, Bottled in Bond).
lots.reason: Rum, not whisky. Interesting vintage miniatures but title already says what they are; low value.
lots.bottling_era: 1950s to 1970s: proof strength labelling, Bottled in Bond, screw caps.
lots.condition: Angostura miniature: heavy label foxing and major low fill with foaming residue; John Peel good fill. Ullage warning.
lots.unreadable: Angostura small print: volume, ABV and bottler not legible.
